title: Checkout 502s during flash sale
symptoms: 502 rate 18%, nginx upstream timed out, CPU on checkout-web pods at 95%
root_cause: HPA max replicas capped at 6, traffic tripled during a flash sale
resolution: Raised HPA max to 20 and pre-scaled to 12; added sale-calendar check to release checklist

title: Kafka consumer lag exploding on notifications
symptoms: consumer lag > 2M, one partition stuck, repeated deserialization exceptions in logs
root_cause: Poison message with malformed JSON blocked partition 7
resolution: Skipped offset via kafka-consumer-groups reset for that partition, added dead-letter topic
failed_attempts: Adding more consumers did nothing since one partition was blocked

title: Login failures for partner SSO
symptoms: SAML assertion validation failed, only partner-org users affected, started at 00:00 UTC
resolution: Imported renewed IdP cert; created 30-day expiry alert on all federation certs
failed_attempts: Clearing session cache had no effect

title: payments-api latency spike after deploy v2.31.0
symptoms: p99 latency 3.8s, 5xx climbing to 9%, 'HikariPool-1 - Connection is not available, request timed out after 30000ms', started 5 min after deploy
root_cause: New reconciliation query in v2.31.0 held connections open inside a transaction (missing index caused 20s scans), exhausting the pool
resolution: Rolled back to v2.30.4 (recovered in 4 min), then terminated idle-in-transaction sessions on primary; shipped index in v2.31.1
failed_attempts: Restarting pods reproduced the exhaustion within 6 minutes

title: Pool exhaustion again, pool size increase made it worse
symptoms: Hikari connection timeouts, DB CPU at 85%, p99 latency 5s
root_cause: Slow bulk-export job hammering primary; not a pool sizing problem
resolution: Killed export job, moved exports to read replica, rate limited the export endpoint
failed_attempts: Raising maximumPoolSize from 30 to 80 pushed DB CPU to 100% and caused a full outage for 12 extra minutes. Team decision: never raise pool size as a first response.

title: Search returning stale results
symptoms: index age 9h, ingestion pipeline green, redis hit ratio 99%
root_cause: Redis maxmemory reached with allkeys-lru evicting the index-version key
resolution: Flushed cache namespace, raised maxmemory, pinned version key with no-eviction DB

title: Log node disk full, ingest halted
symptoms: No space left on device, elasticsearch read-only index block
root_cause: ILM policy failed silently after upgrade, old indices never rolled over
resolution: Deleted indices older than 30d, cleared read-only block, repaired ILM policy
failed_attempts: Adding disk without clearing the block left indices read-only

title: Replica lag 40 min after failover
symptoms: replication lag 2400s, read traffic returning old orders
root_cause: Long-running analytics query on replica blocked WAL replay (recovery conflict)
resolution: Cancelled query, set max_standby_streaming_delay=30s, routed analytics to a dedicated replica
failed_attempts: Restarting replica caused a full resync (extra 25 min)
